'''Zombie warrior''' is a [[monster]] encountered during [[Ancient Awakening]] and in the standard mode of the [[Ungael combat activity]].

During Ancient Awakening their [[life points]] are reduced to 70% of the value seen in the standard mode of the Ungael combat activity. Six of them ambush the player and their expedition party when they first arrive on [[Ungael]], along with two [[skeleton knight]]s. They are later fought in the tower during the quest, where four of them appear in the first wave, two in the second wave, one in the third wave, two in the fourth wave, two in the fifth wave, one in the sixth wave, three in the seventh wave, three in the eighth wave, two in the ninth wave, and one in the eleventh wave, along with many other monsters.

A non-attackable variant is seen just before the waves in the tower start.

In the standard mode of the Ungael combat activity four of them appear in the first wave, two in the second wave, one in the fourth wave, two in the fifth wave, one in the sixth wave, and one in the eleventh wave, along with many other monsters.
